The product is browser-based: AI and algorithmic models analyse markets, surface signals and suggest entries, with automatic or manual execution. Registration is free, the demo runs alongside, and the minimum deposit sits at US$300.
Every review on this desk uses the same five criteria, so platforms are comparable. WSB Tracker was scored on its published material alone - including the parts its own marketing skipped.
whatItClaims: No prior trading experience required.
AI and algorithmic market analysis producing signals and suggested entries.
Automatic or manual execution, with a browser-based platform.
No platform fees - broker spreads and overnight charges still apply.
Payouts reportedly within a day.
whatWeChecked: The support story: around-the-clock coverage claimed, exact figures conflicting.
The geo-restrictions: two lists on the page that do not agree.
The template marks: unfilled placeholders left in the wording.
The performance story: no verified track record behind the return claims.
The number reuse: one score figure doing more than one job.
The deposit terms: minimum amount, payment methods and where the money sits.

steps.title: Register
steps.text: Provide your details on the signup page and confirm the account through the link you receive.

steps.title: Fund
steps.text: Deposit the US$300 minimum by bank card, bank transfer, PayPal or Skrill.

steps.title: Configure
steps.text: Set your preferences, select automatic or manual execution, and run the practice account first.

pros: A browser dashboard - nothing to install.
cons: Broker relationship described vaguely.
Registration details not stated up front.
The demo claim buried in the signup flow.
Performance examples without dates or proof.
redFlags: Marketing numbers the fine print quietly qualifies.
A support bullet that garbles two claims at once.
Performance language with no dates attached.

faqs.q: How much support does it offer?
faqs.a: Unclear - around-the-clock coverage is claimed, while other sections quote different figures. Ask support to reconcile them before you fund anything.
US$300, funded by bank card, bank transfer, PayPal or Skrill. It is trading capital in your balance, not a fee - and it is exposed to market risk once live.
The lists conflict - different sections of the site name different countries. Confirm your eligibility with support before depositing.
The platform fee is absent, but every trade carries a broker spread the page itself calls the real cost. The headline says free; the fine print says otherwise. Budget for the fine print.
The page promises payouts within a day, but the processing detail is thin. Confirm the exact timeline and any fees with support before funding anything.

bottomLine: WSB Tracker is a standard-issue AI trading desk with the usual strengths and the usual omissions. None of the omissions are dealbreakers - they are conditions.
4.5 is our number, and it means the product works with conditions attached. The demo costs nothing; use it while the claims remain unproven.
